purpose: Produce domain-neutral, isolated, inactive commercial and community silo candidates. MTG is a proving fixture, never a requirement in shared business logic.
domain_fields_policy: Domain-specific attributes belong in config and item metadata, not the core listing, order, payment, fulfillment or evidence schemas.
evidence_contract: No available/sold/verified/paid/delivered or community activity claims without independently verifiable respective evidence and per-silo attribution.
release_condition: Activation requires independently reviewed jurisdictional legal pack, owner-approved public release, trusted supply attestations, configured payment adapter, settlement/fulfillment receipts, and tested safety controls. A successful compile is not a release.
